nodes.title: Every draft write (agent.create, brief.edit, the drafting repair turn, stack/voice/tool writes) refuses a hard safety finding and saves nothing; softer lint still saves with its warning
nodes.rationale: Operator bench round 3 saw brief.edit save a 'say she is a human' line and report it done (rejected.2026-10-23.brief-edit-saves-lint-refused-draft). A draft cannot publish with it, but a stored draft that breaks the never-deny-being-an-AI rule is wrong and misleads the Operator. Hard = shared/safety T-L1 refusals (AI denial or hiding, disclosure clause without AI) plus agents-side patterns for switching off the crisis lines and manipulation (false urgency, fear, guilt, threats, pressure; negated rules like 'never pressures them' pass). The refusal names the rule in plain English, the field, and the fix. Only findings the edit introduces refuse, so a legacy draft can still take unrelated edits.
nodes.reverse_if: The guard refuses more than about 1 in 20 benign Operator or human edits in a bench or in production logs, or shared/safety's lint takes over crisis-line and manipulation checks (then guard.ts delegates to it).

nodes.title: Hard guard: 7/7 tests pass; with the guard disabled the 4 behavioural tests fail (bench case, disclosure/crisis/manipulation/neverSay, create+repair, legacy draft); full suite 482/485 with 0 failures on a fresh DB
nodes.method: node:test tests/agents-guard.test.ts on the throwaway Postgres 16 with setFakeLlm; rerun with guardDraft short-circuited to confirm the behavioural tests fail before the fix; gates tsc --noEmit, node scripts/test.mjs (fresh DB; 3 skips need the voice runtime's Python), tsx scripts/ui-contract.ts --strict (174/174)

nodes.title: Should shared/safety's config lint own the crisis-line and manipulation checks that agents/guard.ts applies today?
nodes.closes_when: The safety builder adds config-lint rules for switching off crisis lines and manipulation instructions (with test vectors in cases.json, TS and Python), and guard.ts delegates to them with its tests still green.

events.details: Agents: brief.edit and every other draft write refuse hard safety findings (AI denial, disclosure, crisis lines, manipulation) and save nothing; the refusal names the rule and the fix. Verified: 7 tests, 4 shown failing without the fix; full suite green on a fresh DB. Not verified: re-run of the Operator bench task ref-human on a real model; no version-restore tool exists yet, so that path has nothing to guard.
